Five-Star Hong Kong Sky-High Indulgence with Seven Award-Winning Restaurants

Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong

Take a moment's pause and relax at the peaceful Island Shangri-La, where signature luxury and tranquil views of the iconic Peak and Victoria Harbour make for an idyllic escape in the heart of Hong Kong. Step through the lobby doors and see the 140-year-old Banyan Tree taking up residence, a perfect greeting to this urban oasis. Seven award-winning restaurants and bars will delight foodies with a wide array of culinary delights from French fine dining at the Michelin-starred Restaurant Petrus to a bountiful buffet at cafe TOO. For artisanal cocktails, oysters and live jazz music, head to Lobster Bar for a lively night in. And when you're ready to venture out, Pacific Place Mall is just a two-minute walk away and houses many internationally renowned shopping brands, a cinema and countless food options.
